[[Category:First level Basin Guardians]]
[[sn:Pacifica, Goddess of the Pacific Ocean]]Pacifica, Goddess of the Pacific Ocean - A serene and gentle goddess, presiding over the vastness of the Pacific Ocean with tranquility and harmony. She is known for her calming influence on the seas, soothing storms and bringing peace to the waters. She is also associated with marine life and is believed to be a patroness of fishermen and sailors.
